content.title: Real Madrid vs Bayern Munich 1-2: Champions League – as it happened
content.text: 7 Apr 2026 - 21:35 (21:35 GMT)That’s a wrap!Al Jazeera’s live coverage of Real Madrid vs Bayern Munich in the Champions League quarterfinals has come to an end.Thank you for tuning in tonight, and we will be back soon with more action from the world of football.Goodbye!7 Apr 2026 - 21:32 (21:32 GMT)Report: Kane leads Bayern to 2-1 win over Real Madrid in Champions League thrillerLuis Diaz and Harry Kane scored the goals that gave dominant Bayern Munich a crucial 2-1 Champions League quarterfinal first-leg win over Real Madrid.Kylian Mbappe’s strike 16 minutes from time on Tuesday gave record 15-time winners Real a lifeline at their Bernabeu home in a gripping battle.Read this and more in our comprehensive match report.7 Apr 2026 - 21:30 (21:30 GMT)Kane ‘really happy’ with Bayern’s win in Madrid“We knew before the game all the hype around it. Coming to Madrid and the Bernabeu and trying to get a result is always a difficult thing to do,” Kane told TNT Sports.“We played some really good stuff today, for sure. Some areas we could have done better, as well; maybe the final ball and the final finish – we had some good chances there.“But credit to them, they did as well, and Manuel [Neuer] made some really good saves. Overall, we can be really happy with the win.”7 Apr 2026 - 21:28 (21:28 GMT)Let’s hear from Real Madrid goalkeeper Lunin“At least one of [Bayern’s] goals was avoidable, but we reacted well to going behind,” Madrid goalkeeper Lunin told Movistar.“If [Manuel] Neuer’s won Player of the Match, it means we attacked a lot.”7 Apr 2026 - 21:22 (21:22 GMT)More to come on Al Jazeera SportOur focus shifts to Wednesday’s Champions League action.Al Jazeera will bring you live updates from Barcelona vs Atletico Madrid, as the first leg of this quarterfinal clash kicks off at 9pm (19:00 GMT).Our live coverage of the game, to be played at the iconic Camp Nou, will start from 16:00 GMT.7 Apr 2026 - 21:12 (21:12 GMT)‘We’re still alive’: Rudiger after Real Madrid’s defeat“We came out after half-time and screwed up again; both goals we conceded were gifts,” Rudiger told Movistar TV. “In the second half, we needed more.“We’ve spoken about these things, not losing simple balls. But it happened in the two goals. At this level, it’s very dangerous.“We’re still alive, with Mbappe’s goal. We had occasions to score more goals, too, but it ended as it did.“Today, Bayern’s best player was their goalkeeper Neuer. We still have faith; we always do.”7 Apr 2026 - 21:09 (21:09 GMT)Mbappe closing in on a Champions League recordKylian Mbappe is three goals short of the most goals in a single Champions League campaign, with Cristiano Ronaldo netting 17 for Madrid in 2013-14.Ronaldo scored 16 for Los Blancos in 2015-16; Robert Lewandowski (Bayern in 2019-20), Ronaldo (Madrid in 2017-18) and Karim Benzema (Madrid in 2021-22) also each scored 15 in a season.7 Apr 2026 - 21:06 (21:06 GMT)Quick recap: Kane leads Bayern to 2-1 win over Real MadridEngland captain Harry Kane scored the winning goal as Bayern Munich earned a crucial 2-1 victory away to Real Madrid in the Champions League quarterfinal first leg on Tuesday.Colombia winger Luis Diaz opened the scoring just before half-time, with Kane doubling the visitors’ advantage within 30 seconds of the restart.France striker Kylian Mbappe reduced the arrears, but the German champions held on for a vital first-leg lead.Get instant alerts and updates based on your interests. Be the first to know when big stories happen.7 Apr 2026 - 21:03 (21:03 GMT)Neuer named player of the matchBayern Munich goalkeeper Neuer has been named Player of the Match.The UEFA Technical Observer Group said: “He showed great composure in key moments, making very important saves and showing outstanding ability in one-on-one situations”.7 Apr 2026 - 20:58 (20:58 GMT)What’s next?The teams will meet for the second leg in Munich next Wednesday, April 15, at Allianz Arena.The winner will proceed to the semifinals, which are followed by the grand finale on May 30 at the Puskas Arena in Budapest, Hungary.
